# sap — 2018 high-value CVEs (CVSS>=7, CISA KEV, Exploit-DB, or SSVC exploitation active/poc)

Full records for all 131 sap CVEs of 2018 are in `data/cve/vendors/sap/2018.jsonl`.

### CVE-2018-2380
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2018-03-01 | Updated: 2025-10-21 | Max CVSS: 6.6
- CWE: Directory/Path Traversal; CWE-22 CWE-22 Improper Limitation of a Pathname to a Restricted Directory ('Path Traversal')
- CVSS 3.1 (CISA-ADP): 6.6 MEDIUM `CVSS:3.1/AV:N/AC:L/PR:H/UI:N/S:C/C:L/I:L/A:L`
- SSVC (CISA-ADP): Exploitation=active, Automatable=no, Technical Impact=partial
- **CISA KEV**: added 2021-11-03, ransomware=Known — SAP Customer Relationship Management (CRM) Path Traversal Vulnerability
- Exploit-DB 44292: SAP NetWeaver AS JAVA CRM - Log injection Remote Command Execution (remote/windows, 2018-03-14, verified=0)

SAP CRM, 7.01, 7.02,7.30, 7.31, 7.33, 7.54, allows an attacker to exploit insufficient validation of path information provided by users, thus characters representing "traverse to parent directory" are passed through to the file APIs.

Affected:
- SAP SE / SAP CRM: affected 7.01; affected 7.02; affected 7.30; affected 7.31; affected 7.33; affected 7.54

### CVE-2018-2402
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2018-03-14 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: 7.6
- CWE: Information Disclosure
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.6 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:H/PR:H/UI:R/S:C/C:H/I:H/A:H`

In systems using the optional capture & replay functionality of SAP HANA, 1.00 and 2.00, (see SAP Note 2362820 for more information about capture & replay), user credentials may be stored in clear text in the indexserver trace files of the control system. An attacker with the required authorizations on the control system may be able to access the user credentials and gain unauthorized access to data in the captured or target system.

Affected:
- SAP SE / SAP HANA: affected 1.0; affected 2.0

References:
- https://blogs.sap.com/2018/03/13/sap-security-patch-day-march-2018/ [x_refsource_CONFIRM]
- http://www.securityfocus.com/bid/103369 [vdb-entry,x_refsource_BID]
- https://launchpad.support.sap.com/#/notes/2587369 [x_refsource_CONFIRM]

### CVE-2018-2408
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2018-04-10 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: 7.3
- CWE: Other
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 7.3 HIGH `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:L/I:L/A:L`

Improper Session Management in SAP Business Objects, 4.0, from 4.10, from 4.20, 4.30, CMC/BI Launchpad/Fiorified BI Launchpad. In case of password change for a user, all other active sessions created using older password continues to be active.

Affected:
- SAP SE / SAP Business Objects: affected 4.00; affected from 4.10; affected from 4.20; affected 4.30

### CVE-2018-2424
- Assigner: sap | Published: 2018-06-12 | Updated: 2024-08-05 | Max CVSS: 9.8
- CWE: Cross-Site Scripting
- CVSS 3.0 (cna): 9.8 CRITICAL `CVSS:3.0/AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H`

SAP UI5 did not validate user input before adding it to the DOM structure. This may lead to malicious user-provided JavaScript code being added to the DOM that could steal user information. Software components affected are: SAP Hana Database 1.00, 2.00; SAP UI5 1.00; SAP UI5 (Java) 7.30, 7.31, 7.40, 7,50; SAP UI 7.40, 7.50, 7.51, 7.52, and version 2.0 of SAP UI for SAP NetWeaver 7.00

Affected:
- SAP SE / SAP HANA Database: affected 1.0; affected 2.0
- SAP SE / SAP UI5: affected 1.0
- SAP SE / SAP UI5(Java): affected 7.3; affected 7.31; affected 7.40; affected 7.50
- SAP SE / SAP UI: affected 7.40; affected 7.50; affected 7.51; affected 7.52
- SAP SE / SAP UI for SAP NetWeaver 7.00: affected 2.0
